messages:

Cc: security@aurorahealth.com

Subject: SOC2/CAIQ intake — telemetry, tenant isolation, and upload questions

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for picking this up. Aurora is starting our SIG/CAIQ review for Redwood as part of procurement. A few items we
want to cover on the intake call:
- Tenant segmentation / per-tenant telemetry sampling (we need documentation of logical separation and sampling knobs)
- Example telemetry payloads (we'll need to validate redaction capability before sharing PII-like fields)
- Log storage and retention (S3 buckets, kms keys, where logs live and who can access them)
- Evidence transfer: preferred upload method and size limits

Can you confirm availability for a 45-min call next Tue or Wed (Nov 24/25) morning PST? Also attaching a preliminary SIG spreadsheet and our data classification CSV so you can see the ask matrix.

Attachments:
- Aurora_SIG_Preliminary.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- data_classification.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Ellie Carter

Subject: Re: SOC2/CAIQ intake — telemetry, tenant isolation, and upload questions

Ellie — thanks for the attachments and the clear list. We can take those items in a single 45-min intake. Proposed slots:
- Tue 2026-11-24 09:00–09:45 PST
- Tue 2026-11-24 11:00–11:45 PST
- Wed 2026-11-25 09:30–10:15 PST

Short plan for the call:
1) Quick intro & scope (5 min)
2) Tenant segmentation and logical isolation (10 min) — Laura will cover architecture and RBAC boundaries
3) Telemetry payloads & redaction controls (15 min) — Neha will show sample flows and sampling flags
4) Evidence transfer/runbook (10 min) — I will outline upload options + temporary presigned link flow
5) Actions & next steps (5 min)

Pre-call asks (so we can prepare samples):
- Which environments do you want samples from (prod/staging)?
- Are you able to share a short list of the SIG questions you want us to prioritize?

We will send a short intake runbook and a secure upload link prior to the call. For large telemetry exports we typically provide an S3 presigned ingest endpoint or SFTP with multipart upload guidance.

Final note on access: we can provide redacted log samples and a sanitized run of our sampling component; full raw logs require a limited transfer agreement (we can point you to the redaction template).

If any of the proposed times work, say which and we'll lock it.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer — Security Ops
Redwood Inference

Ellie — looping in a few clarifications so we can bring the right artifacts.
- Retention: default telemetry retention is 90 days hot, 365 days cold; we can export longer windows on request (export is snapshot-based).
- Tenant isolation: our logical tenancy is enforced at the routing/proxy layer + per-tenant KMS key scoping for long-term storage. Laura can share the access matrix on the call.
- Sampling knobs: we have service flags to enable per-tenant sampling rates (we can show a demo snippet).

I've uploaded a short example schema and a redaction checklist to our evidence runbook (link below). For the pre-call, if you can indicate whether you need PHI-sanitized samples or just structurally representative payloads, we'll prepare accordingly.

Attachment:
- log_schema_example.txt (schema + example)

Link: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/s/evidence-runbook-v2

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Engineer
